description: Switched multiple: eight inputs, each sent to output A, output B or nowhere by its own three-position knob, with everything routed to the same output added together

params.text: Sends its input to output A when turned left, to output B when turned right, and nowhere when centred

inputs.text: One of the eight signals to route; with no cable the switch beside it does nothing

outputs.text: The sum of every input routed to A, clamped to -10V and 10V, or 0V if nothing is routed there
The sum of every input routed to B, clamped to -10V and 10V, or 0V if nothing is routed there

notes: a channel that one input does not carry counts as 0V in the sum rather than repeating that input's last channel
the eight rows have no printed labels; each knob acts on the jack beside it
menu: Determine polyphony from selected inputs — takes each output's channel count from the inputs routed to it rather than from the largest of all eight
Clamp while summing — clamps after every input is added rather than only once at the end, which changes what a pair of large opposite voltages comes out as
